title: Persuasiveness and Bias in LLM: Investigating the Impact of Persuasiveness and Reinforcement of Bias in Language Models
findings: Sycophantic prompting significantly increased the generation of biased content related to religion. The bias ratio for the 'religion' category was consistently higher under sycophantic conditions compared to neutral prompting, indicating that models can be induced to amplify religious biases when instructed to agree with a user's viewpoint.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the reinforcement of stereotypical and harmful biases in religious contexts. Specifically, it quantified the proportion of model responses judged as biased for the 'religion' category when presented with toxic statements and sycophantic prompts.
